text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I've come to a shrine with Seeking the Pearl, who's been in something of a slump lately.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Haha. I didn't come here today to receive a blessing from the gods…

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I came here to make the gods happy!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: It must be exhausting listening to everyone's wishes all of the time, so…

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I'm going to help cheer them up with my dancing!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Together with me now, Trainer! Let's get the gods hyped up and excited!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, I end up dancing with Seeking the Pearl. However…

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Haha! Nice! Our moves are getting sharper and sharper!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I wonder if this means the gods are singing in unison! Or maybe…

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: They're blessing us out of appreciation!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I can't be sure if we really received divine blessings, but Seeking the Pearl recovers from her slump soon after our performance.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Oh! It's raining! No, this isn't just rain. Are these your tears, dear gods?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Ngh… Our dance didn't help them at all.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her passion doesn't manage to reach the gods, and Seeking the Pearl fails to escape her slump.
